E4Plus1.uk.description: Waverly Hills, 9-0-2-1-D'oh: The family rent a flat in the affluent Waverly Hills area so that Bart and Lisa can get into a good school. (S20 Ep19/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: If You Build It: Following Murray's death, Adam, Barry and Erica all come home to be closer to Mum. (S10 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: That's a Schwartz Man: Adam is worried about how Beverly will handle him going off to college, so he tries to get a dream job right in their hometown. (S10 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Pontiac Bandit Returns: Doug Judy is back in custody after scamming Peralta and Diaz when they last met, but Captain Holt offers him a plea deal. (S2 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dee Dee's plan to meet her teacher after school goes awry. Dodger encourages Donny to face his problems head on.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Arguments erupt in the Hutchinson household. Gemma turns to her dad Donny for help. And Leah flees the hospital in search of answers.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sheep.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4Plus1.uk.description: In Gloucestershire, a farmhouse feast competes with a Mexican menu and a Japanese theme, in a week featuring a bizarre breakdancing demo and proposal pressures.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Handlebar: Gordon Ramsay takes on a time warp at the Handlebar restaurant and lounge in Mount Sinai, New York, where the owners are stuck in the 80s with an unenthusiastic chef. (S2 Ep6) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Sabatiello's: Gordon Ramsay sets his sights on Sabatiello's, an Italian restaurant in Connecticut that's better known for its owner Sammy's tantrums than the food. (S2 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mojito: Gordon Ramsay visits a Cuban café in Brooklyn, where owners Marcelo and Kata fight over everything, driving away customers with their high-volume bickering. (S3 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dance Dance Revelation: Everyone gets in on the fun at Luke and Manny's first school dance. A trip to the mall with the boys becomes stressful for Jay and Phil. (S2 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Slow Down Your Neighbors: Claire becomes a determined neighbourhood vigilante hoping to catch and stop a menacing car that speeds through the streets. (S2 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Ziff Who Came to Dinner: The Simpsons find Marge's high school prom date Artie Ziff squatting in their loft, and he's planning to frame Homer... (S15 Ep14/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Co-Dependent's Day: The Simpsons go to California so that Bart and Lisa can tell the Cosmic Wars creator what they think of his latest film. (S15 Ep15/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Wandering Juvie: After Bart scams the town out of wedding presents, he is sent to juvenile detention. But he ends up on the run, chained to a female inmate. (S15 Ep16/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: My Big Fat Geek Wedding: On the eve of their nuptials, Edna calls it all off with Principal Skinner. As Marge consoles Edna, she realises her own relationship isn't so great. (S15 Ep17/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: 12 Tapes for a Penny: Adam joins a mail-order music club, hoping to assemble a huge tape collection. Barry realises that Lainey's father doesn't like him. (S3 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Magic Is Real: Adam tries to use his new magic act to attract girls at school, but Beverly insists on taking to the stage as his assistant, which really doesn't help at all. (S3 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Go Bullfrogs!: Phil takes Haley to visit his alma mater. Claire goes out with Mitchell and Cameron. Gloria and Jay may have to broach a delicate subject with Manny. (S3 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: After the Fire: The Pritchetts rally for a good cause after a neighbour's house burns down, but there's a downside to their Samaritan intentions when Jay throws out his back. (S3 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Punkin Chunkin: When an old neighbourhood kid returns to town as a hugely successful internet billionaire, it gets Phil thinking of what could have been. (S3 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Express Christmas: The Pritchett clan decide to celebrate Christmas a little early so they split up to gather the holiday trappings as Mitchell, Alex and Lily hunt for a tree. (S3 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Love Is in the N2-O2-Ar-CO2-Ne-He-CH4: Professor Frink uses science to turn into a ladies' man. And medication makes Grampa and the Retirement Castle residents hallucinate. (S27 Ep13/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gal of Constant Sorrow: Bart and Lisa get to know a homeless folk singer. Homer's attempt at DIY traps the cat in the walls of the house, so he launches a rescue bid. (S27 Ep14/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa the Veterinarian: Lisa is inspired to become a vet and begins an internship at a local surgery. Marge gets a job as a crime scene cleaner but finds it traumatic. (S27 Ep15/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Marge-ian Chronicles: When Lisa signs up to participate in the future colonisation of Mars, Marge's attempt to use reverse psychology to discourage her goes badly wrong. (S27 Ep16/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mercedes' birthday gets off to a rocky start. And a chase ensues when Imran finds Lucas in Chester, but things take a dangerous turn...

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Stakeout: Peralta and Boyle go on an eight-day stakeout, putting a strain on their friendship. Holt's nephew visits and makes an instant impression on Diaz. (S2 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: The dating hopefuls include a builder who's finally ready for a concrete relationship, a naked bike rider, a pair of gamers, and a man who's been married five times already... (S12 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Ramsay's Kitchen...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Nightmares USA: Brand new series - Lyla's Family Restaurant (Part 2/2): Owner Waleed's hopes and dreams go up in flames when a fire breaks out at his restaurant's big relaunch. (S10 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers watch the Queen's funeral, The Masked Dancer, Frozen Planet II, Bad Sisters, The Grand Tour: A Scandi Flick and Secret Crush. (S20 Ep3)
